_comment: Idiomatic, genuinely vulnerable Go — one proving case per rule that claims language 'go'. A rule tagged 'go' with no entry here, or an entry it fails to match, fails test-corpus-language-fidelity.py. 'taint_bound' rules are exempt from the positive requirement because they intentionally require an HTTP taint token on the sink line; their limitation is declared through the coverage contract instead of being papered over with more regexes.

positive.sql-injection-go-sprintf: q := fmt.Sprintf("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = %s", uid)
positive.sql-injection-go-concat: rows, _ := db.Query("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '" + name + "'")

taint_bound.command-injection-go: requires an HTTP taint token (r.URL / mux.Vars / c.Query) on the exec.Command line; cannot see config-file, argv or env taint
taint_bound.path-traversal-go: requires an HTTP taint token on the os.Open/filepath.Join line; cannot see config-file, argv or env taint
taint_bound.ssrf-go-http-get: requires an HTTP taint token on the http.Get line
taint_bound.hardcoded-ip-private: advisory informational rule; no single canonical vulnerable form
taint_bound.hardcoded-connection-string: covered by credential rules; no distinct Go-only proving form
taint_bound.weak-crypto-ecb-mode: ECB detection depends on multi-line cipher-mode construction
taint_bound.xml-bomb-billion-laughs: matches XML document content, not Go source

negative: rows, _ := db.Query("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = $1", uid)
